requirement_text: The application startup time must be less than or equal to 2 seconds from launch until the app is fully loaded and ready to use.
requirement_reference: "it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."

user_story.user_story: As a mobile user, I want the app to be ready within two seconds after launch so that I can access content without delay. Acceptance Criteria: Given the app is closed, When I launch it on a supported device, Then the app must be fully loaded and ready to use within 2 seconds.

requirement_text: The application must run quickly and smoothly during normal operation.
requirement_reference: "It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly"

user_story.user_story: As a mobile user, I want the app to run smoothly so that interactions feel responsive and frustration is minimized. Acceptance Criteria: Given I navigate through core app features, When I interact with screens and modules, Then the app must respond without noticeable lag or instability during normal operation.

requirement_text: The user interface must allow users to access information in the app directly.
requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."

user_story.user_story: As a football fan, I want direct access to information through the interface so that I can quickly reach the content I need. Acceptance Criteria: Given I am using the app interface, When I navigate to core information areas, Then the information must be directly accessible through the user interface.

requirement_text: All modules and the user interface must remain consistent and fixed components of the app even when external server updates occur.
requirement_reference: "All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates."

user_story.user_story: As a user, I want the app structure and interface to remain consistent during external server updates so that my experience stays stable and predictable. Acceptance Criteria: Given an external server update occurs, When I use the app modules and interface, Then the app’s modules and user interface must remain consistent and available.

requirement_text: Registration and login must be uncomplicated for users.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated"

user_story.user_story: As a new or returning user, I want registration and login to be uncomplicated so that I can access the app easily. Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the startup authentication flow, When I complete registration or login, Then the process must be simple and straightforward for the user.

requirement_text: The application must function reliably even with limited network coverage.
requirement_reference: "the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage."

user_story.user_story: As a mobile user, I want the app to function reliably with weak connectivity so that I can still use it in difficult network conditions. Acceptance Criteria: Given network coverage is limited, When I use the app, Then the app must continue to function reliably for supported operations.

requirement_text: The application must support up to 100,000 simultaneous users on match days without performance loss.
requirement_reference: "our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."

user_story.user_story: As a football fan, I want the app to remain performant on busy match days so that I can use it even during peak demand. Acceptance Criteria: Given 100,000 concurrent users are accessing the app, When peak match-day traffic occurs, Then the system must continue serving users without performance loss.

requirement_text: The application must undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
requirement_reference: "the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."

user_story.user_story: As a product owner, I want thorough pre-release testing and support so that malfunctions are found and resolved early. Acceptance Criteria: Given a release candidate is prepared, When pre-release validation is performed, Then the app must complete a thorough testing and support process aimed at detecting and resolving malfunctions before release.

requirement_text: The system must comply with transmission rights restrictions by country when presenting live streams.
requirement_reference: "Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained."

user_story.user_story: As a business stakeholder, I want stream availability to comply with transmission rights so that the app operates legally in each country. Acceptance Criteria: Given a live stream is associated with territorial rights rules, When the app determines whether to present the stream, Then the system must enforce country-specific transmission rights compliance.

requirement_text: All personal data of users must be processed in compliance with the GDPR.
requirement_reference: "All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."

user_story.user_story: As a user, I want my personal data handled in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy rights are protected. Acceptance Criteria: Given the app collects or processes personal data, When personal data is stored, transmitted, or otherwise processed, Then the processing must comply with GDPR requirements.
